name: Heal
targets: 1 willing living creature or 1 undead creature

heightening.text: The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8|1-10|1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8|1-10|8.

entries: You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.
1 The spell has a range of touch.
2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.
3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.
